proposed_comments.title: Preserve visible window modes and the non-elevated fallback
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve visible window modes and the non-elevated fallback

**Severity:** `high`

`Minimized` and `Maximized` are visible launch modes, but `ShouldUseExplorerShell` currently accepts only `Normal`; both therefore take the CreateProcess branch with `showWindow=false` and launch hidden. Normal visible mappings also fail outright when Explorer COM activation is unavailable, even though the previous parent-process path can still launch ordinary executables non-elevated. Route every non-hidden mode through Explorer with its matching `SW_SHOW*` value, retain a CreateProcess fallback, carry the same show command through that fallback instead of reducing it to a boolean, and add direct routing coverage for minimized and maximized mappings.
